malaria._src: card rule #1 + FORK 3 (repeat every 12-24 h x >= 3; negative only after >= 100 thick fields); 317331 digest Part 2 Lab Dx (negative set -> repeat 12-24 h)

stool_routine._src: 317331 digest §5.1 (routine = 1). A routine single negative is NOT a rule-out (card trap: single stool = false negative).
